description: Observed clouds for net9010. Temperatures, distances and beams are ASSUMPTIONS used to convert the maps to the training units (velocities / c_s) and to set the resolution channel; edit them here, nothing is hard-coded in predict_observations_net9010.py.

notes.T_K: 10 K for the dark clouds and 20 K for Orion are placeholders; c_s scales as sqrt(T), so the predicted Ms scales as 1/sqrt(T) through the velocity channels
notes.beam_arcsec: FCRAO 13CO ~46 arcsec on 23 arcsec pixels; NRO 45m 13CO 25.8 arcsec (Shimajiri et al. 2014); CfA 8.4 arcmin
notes.taurus: 12CO, 0.65 km/s channels and a ~39 pc tile: far outside the training data, reported only as a sanity check
notes.orion: Orion A (Shimajiri et al. 2014). Orkisz et al. 2017 (Ms ~ 6, mostly solenoidal) is Orion B, a different cloud. 0.5 km/s channels.
notes.Ms_literature: fill from linewidth-based estimates (use observed linewidths, not derived dissipation times)

references.perseus: Arce et al. 2010 Table 5: 13CO FWHM 1.5-2.2 km/s, Tex 10-15 K over 0.6-2 pc regions (Ms ~5-8); Padoan et al. 2003: sigma_v = 2.0 km/s over ~30 pc (Ms ~14); Pineda et al. 2008: 13CO saturates above Av ~ 5
references.taurus: Padoan et al. 2003: sigma_v = 1.0 km/s (Ms ~7); Panopoulou et al. 2014 use the FCRAO 13CO Taurus survey (consider replacing the CfA 12CO cube)
references.ophiuchus: White et al. 2015 is JCMT CO/13CO/C18O J=3-2 of L1688, not the FCRAO 13CO(1-0) map used here
references.serpens: Gong et al. 2021: IRAM-30m/APEX 13CO/C18O of the Serpens filament (0.07 pc, <=0.1 km/s)

notes.min_channels: voxels must be above mask_sigma in >= min_channels consecutive channels (removes isolated noise spikes); 1 = old behaviour
notes.Ms_tile_spectrum: matched-scale observational Ms per tile: sqrt(3) x sigma of the tile-averaged masked spectrum / c_s(T_K); the network predicts the 3D Ms of a box the size of the tile
notes.serpens: serpens_13co_xyv.fit.gz has edge-channel noise ~1.3 K, as large as the line (~1.2 K), so nothing passes 3 sigma; 13co10.fits has 0.16 K noise and a 1.5 K line, 24.8" beam (BMAJ), 121x121 pixels (upsampled to 128).
